_help: This file is the merch store. Edit it on GitHub, then click 'Commit changes'. The site updates in about a minute.
take_home_price: what the band keeps per item, in US dollars. The site adds the card fee and rounds up (see settings.json).
status: 'active' (for sale), 'sold_out' (shown greyed out), or 'hidden' (not shown at all).
stock: how many are left in each size. 0 greys that size out. Online card orders lower these numbers automatically.
extra: optional extra take-home dollars for one size, for example 2 for a 2XL that costs more to make.
ships_as: 'letter' for stickers (cheap letter mail if the whole order is letters) or 'parcel' for shirts.
id: a short name with no spaces. Never change an id once something has sold; add a new product instead.
Keep the punctuation exactly as it is: quotes around words, commas between items, no comma after the last item in a list.
